_doc: RI-014 fixture. Anthropic supports cache_control: {type:'ephemeral'} on any content block to mark a prompt-cache breakpoint. The endpoint/messages.rs OUTBOUND path opts into prompt caching unconditionally. On the INBOUND leg, AnthropicContentBlock does not declare cache_control on any of its arms; serde silently drops the field. When a thinking block carries cache_control + signature, the downstream /responses bridge cannot replay the cache marker. This fixture asserts the current pass-through behavior of the content blocks themselves AND documents the cache_control loss as a known gap.

_known_gap.description: cache_control on content blocks is dropped on the inbound leg because AnthropicContentBlock variants do not declare a cache_control field. Downstream /responses sees the content but loses the cache breakpoint, so prompt-cache reuse degrades to full re-tokenization on the next turn.
